title: Where I live
standfirst: One question, one answer, and the three little words that decide it.
summary: à for a town, en for a feminine country, au for a masculine one. The rule the whole topic turns on.

rules.lead: The rule, and it is the whole topic
rules.body: à + a town. en + a feminine country (la or l'). au + a masculine country (le). Get the country's gender from Pack 5 and the word follows.
The h in habite is not said — j'habite is “jah-beet”. It is still written, and the writing test marks spelling.

rules.lead: Question and answer are different words
rules.body: Tu habites où ? is the question. J'habite… is the answer. Mixing them up is the commonest slip in this topic.
